answer: Receipts are issued in lantern, burned on slash in ember, and listed in falcon. The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 30 epochs. That removes the yield a hostile operator would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. A 272 account operation therefore ties up 30 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
